newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows gain in 2-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows gain in 2-day period.

text.p: U.S. stock funds posted industrywide inflows of $1.94 billion for the two days ended June 2 compared with redemptions of $226 million for the three days ended May 29, according to a survey by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund tracking firm said that growth funds had inflows of $753 million versus outflows of $295 million, and growth and income funds had inflows of $1.14 billion versus inflows of $440 million.
International funds had inflows of $795 million versus outflows of $501 million.

Bond funds had inflows of $1.37 billion versus outflows of $91 million. Muni funds had inflows of $501 million versus outflows of $253 million. Government/GNMA funds had inflows of $194 million versus outflows of $82 million. High yield funds had lowered inflows of $61 million versus $142 million.
